title: 第9章 暗教突袭第10章 星痕交易
lines: 雨水顺着旧水泵房的铜管滴下。
洛晖冲出排水渠时，肩头弩伤被雨一冲，血沿着皮甲缝往下淌。手背晶化蓝纹贴着皮肤发烫，赤金尾戒扣在指间，内侧古卷库钥印烧得他指骨发麻。
远处古卷库外墙，一层护盾熄灭。
第二层护盾跟着暗下去。
塔窗里，黑影翻卷，书页碎片被雨卷到半空。
洛晖咬住绷带一端，用牙把肩口勒紧，脚步没有停。
“教授这门禁也太懂事了，敌人来了还自动开门。”
显曜留在权杖里的求救星纹又亮了半息。
蓝白细线刚从空中拉开，黑星火从中间一咬，符线断成两截。
洛晖抬手接住半截星纹残光，掌心蓝火一烧，残光里浮出古卷库内层图影。
封印大厅。
三排古卷。
显曜被黑锁压在中央。
“找到你了。”
中央阶梯前，学生乱成一片。
执纪生举着封锁牌，外墙巡检阵一闪一灭。地面还残着赤金契约纹，商会暗杀留下的痕迹没清干净，毒契约拖住了学院护盾判定。旧钟塔方向，暗鹰回声沿墙根爬动，干扰记录晶阵。黑星火从古卷库旧排气井钻入，把三处破口接成一条暗道。
贝莎抱着医疗包从侧廊跑来，斗篷下摆全是泥水。
“洛晖！显曜教授被困在封印大厅。雷昂在旧钟塔连廊挡刺客，他的炽焰盾还没修好。”
“伤员多少？”
“东廊七个，西翼十二个。贵族派挤在楼梯口堵路，平民新生进不去。”
洛晖一把抽走她怀里的学院布局图，展开扫了两眼。
古卷库像一座竖起来的排水渠。
书架底座是导流槽，封印柱是主阀，旧排气井是暗道入口。
“贝莎，带平民新生去东廊救人。被黑火灼到的记录晶片，全丢进水槽，别问，照做。”
贝莎点头，转身喊人。
“能动的跟我！别挤楼梯，走药剂课侧门！”
雷昂的吼声从旧钟塔连廊传来。
赤火盾壁只剩半面，三名影刃刺客从雾里扑出，刀刃切在盾面上，赤火被压得乱跳。
一名刺客贴着盾缘低笑：“败给贫民的骑士，还替贫民守门？”
雷昂左臂护甲裂开，仍把盾砸在地面。
“学院规矩，不给异教徒踩。”
洛晖冲到连廊口，朝他竖了下拇指。
“雷昂，撑十息。”
雷昂侧身挡下一刀。
“十息后呢？”
“十息后你可以继续撑。”
雷昂手臂一震，半面炽焰盾又往前推了半步。
“你这人真会鼓舞同门。”
绮兰从中央阶梯上方走下，暗红披风被雨打湿，紫银钥片夹在指间。她把一张外围权限路线拍到洛晖手上。
“封印大厅不能强轰。古卷被黑星火点燃，整座学院会变成祭坛。”
洛晖看着图上几条细线。
content_en:
Rain dripped down the copper pipes of the old pump house.
When Luo Hui rushed out of the drainage ditch, the crossbow wound on his shoulder was washed away by the rain, and blood flowed down along the seam of his leather armor. The crystallized blue lines on the back of his hand were hot against the skin, the red gold tail ring was clasped between his fingers, and the ancient scroll key seal on the inside was burning so hard that his finger bones were numb.
On the outer wall of the ancient scroll library in the distance, a layer of shield went out.
The second layer of shields then darkened.
In the tower window, dark shadows rolled around, and fragments of book pages were blown into the air by the rain.
Luo Hui bit one end of the bandage and tightened his shoulders with his teeth, without stopping.
"Professor, this access control is too sensible. When the enemy comes, he will open the door automatically."
The help star pattern left by Xian Yao in the scepter lit up for another half breath.
As soon as the thin blue and white line was pulled out of the air, Black Starfire bit it from the middle, breaking the line into two pieces.
Luo Hui raised his hand to catch half of the remaining light of the star pattern. The blue fire burned in his palm, and the inner image of the ancient scroll library emerged from the remaining light.
Seal the hall.
Three rows of ancient scrolls.
Xian Yao was pressed in the center by the black lock.
"Found you."
In front of the central staircase, students were in chaos.
The law enforcement officer held up the blockade sign, and the inspection array on the outer wall flashed and disappeared. There are still red gold contract patterns on the ground. The traces left by the assassination of the Chamber of Commerce have not been cleaned up. The poisonous contract has hindered the college's shield judgment. In the direction of the old clock tower, the echo of the dark eagle crawled along the walls, interfering with the recording crystal array. Black Spark drilled into the old exhaust shaft of the ancient scroll library and connected the three breaches into a secret tunnel.
Bertha ran from the side corridor with a medical bag in her arms, the hem of her cloak covered in mud and water.
"Luo Hui! Professor Xian Yao is trapped in the sealed hall. Leon is blocking the assassins in the corridor of the old clock tower. His blazing shield has not been repaired yet."
"How many wounded?"
"There are seven in the east corridor and twelve in the west wing. The aristocrats crowded at the stairs and blocked the way, so the civilian freshmen couldn't get in."
Luo Hui took away the college layout map from her arms, unfolded it and glanced at it.
The Scroll Library is like an erected drainage channel.
The base of the bookshelf is the diversion trough, the sealing column is the main valve, and the old exhaust shaft is the entrance to the secret passage.
"Bertha, take the civilian freshmen to the east corridor to rescue people. Throw all the recording chips burned by the black fire into the sink. Don't ask, just do as you are told."
Bertha nodded and turned to call someone.
"Follow me if you can move! Don't squeeze up the stairs, take the side door of the pharmacy class!"
Leon's roar came from the corridor of the old clock tower.
Only half of the Red Fire shield wall was left, and three Shadow Blade Assassins jumped out of the fog. Their blades cut on the shield, causing Red Fire to jump wildly under the pressure.
An assassin chuckled against the edge of the shield: "The knight who lost to the poor still guards the gate for the poor?"
Leon's left arm armor cracked, and the shield still hit the ground.
"The rules of the academy are not to be stepped on by infidels."
Luo Hui rushed to the entrance of the corridor and gave him a thumbs up.
"Leon, hold on for ten breaths."
Leon turned sideways to block the blow.
"What about after ten breaths?"
"You can continue to hold on after ten breaths."
Leon's arm shook, and half of the blazing shield pushed forward half a step.
"You are really an inspiration to your classmates."
Qilan walked down the central staircase, her dark red cloak soaked by the rain, and the purple and silver key held between her fingers. She took a picture of the peripheral authority route and put it in Luo Hui's hand.
"The sealed hall cannot be bombarded. If the ancient scroll is ignited by the Black Spark, the entire academy will become an altar."
Luo Hui looked at the few thin lines on the picture.
